document.title: Report grader eval harness
document.summary: `pnpm eval` pins each case's worktree, runs an isolated producer on skills-next, then grades the review with expect checks and two read-only graders.
document.why: [#52](source:s1) asks for a Cursor SDK script that grades review quality. The [design on #52](source:s3) puts that in a repo-local harness whose exit code follows deterministic checks only.

sources.title: Report grader
sources.gist: Asks for a Cursor SDK script so LLMs grade review quality, with an isolated producer and a trigger after skill changes.

sources.label: PR #68
sources.title: Report grader eval harness
sources.gist: Implements the repo-local eval harness from the #52 design.

sources.label: design on #52
sources.title: Report grader design
sources.gist: Harness in scripts/eval and eval/cases. Constraints in expect, not a gold review. Exit 1 only on deterministic failures. Two read-only graders emit findings.

sources.title: Add a Cursor SDK eval harness that grades review quality

sources.label: 603bbf1
sources.title: Allow in-range GitHub commit URLs in eval source checks
sources.gist: Treats github.com commit URLs as valid when the SHA is in the reviewed range.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Asked to implement the posted design and run it, including the exit-code rule.

lookFor: The [design on #52](source:s3) wants `pnpm eval -- --tag smoke` after skills-next, schema, or review changes, and no CI. `AGENTS.md` adds that line. No workflow file changes.
The [design on #52](source:s3) says LLM findings must not fail the process. `caseFailed` ignores grader findings.
[#52](source:s1) and the [design](source:s3) name a trigger agents can run. `pnpm eval` needs `CURSOR_API_KEY`. That secret is not in this diff.
The [design](source:s3) leaves cigster and comprehende #54 out of the first slice. Those folders are not under `eval/cases`.

groups.title: Case schema and flags
groups.why: Every later step loads `case.json` and argv. Those shapes have to be one contract.
groups.summary: Zod parses `eval/cases/*/case.json`. `parseEvalArgv` selects cases by id or tag and sets the two models.

groups.title: Pin a PR into a worktree
groups.why: The producer reviews a frozen head, not today's branch. `pnpm eval:add` writes that pin.
groups.summary: `add-case` fetches PR JSON with `gh` and records base and head SHAs. `clone.ts` fills a bare cache and adds a detached worktree at head.
lookFor: For this repo, `thisRepoMirror` clones the local checkout and adds a `github` remote for pull refs.

groups.title: Isolated producer
groups.why: [#52](source:s1) requires an isolated agent to write the review from the skill. The [design](source:s3) forbids loading this repo's skills or the network.
groups.summary: `copySkillForEval` rewrites the CLI pin. `runLocalAgent` uses empty `settingSources` and disallows task, search, and MCP.
lookFor: The producer prompt never mentions `expect` or `eval/cases`. Frozen sources skip `gh`.

groups.title: Deterministic checks
groups.why: The [design](source:s3) makes `expect` the pass/fail work. Graders only emit findings.
groups.summary: Checks flag a dirty worktree, invented source URLs, why/parts/size, together/apart, and long or dashed prose. `gradingPacket` is the live hunks those graders read.
lookFor: A GitHub commit URL whose SHA is in `base...head` counts as in-range, not invented. Transcript sources always fail.

groups.title: Read-only graders
groups.why: The [design](source:s3) wants grouping and prose findings that never change the exit code.
groups.summary: Two new agents get only read tools. JSON is Zod-parsed. A second send retries a parse miss.

groups.title: `pnpm eval` orchestrator
groups.why: The [design](source:s3) wants one command after skill, schema, or review changes, with one stdout line per case.
groups.summary: `runEval` walks cases, prints one line each, exports the produced review, and exits 1 only when a deterministic check fails. Package scripts, gitignore, and AGENTS.md wire that command.
lookFor: `caseFailed` is true only for producer errors, validate errors, and `checks.failures`. LLM findings stay on the line as `nM nm`.
Subtle. `durationMs` is set before `writeCaseArtifacts`, so `result.json` matches the summary line.

groups.title: Eval unit tests
groups.why: The new helpers need tests that do not call the SDK.
groups.summary: Case schema, argv, GitHub URLs, checks, packet, graders JSON, skill copy, and `replaceCliPin` have node:test coverage.

groups.title: Frozen first-slice cases
groups.why: The [design](source:s3) starts with seven PRs and constraints in `expect`, not a gold `review.json`.
groups.summary: Each case folder holds `case.json` plus frozen PR, issue, and comment JSON. `#50` and `#57` are tagged smoke.
lookFor: Humans fill `expect`. `eval:add` writes empty expect. The checked-in cases already have constraints.

commits.subject: Allow in-range GitHub commit URLs in eval source checks
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Frozen html_url sets only hold PR, issue, and comment links. A kind-commit source with github.com/.../commit/<sha> is valid when that SHA is in the reviewed range and the URL is this repo.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Record eval case duration before writing result.json
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Also require parse.ts to sit with its tests in the Zod case, not with review.ts. The skill wants that split via dependsOn.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Add a Cursor SDK eval harness that grades review quality
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Isolated producers follow skills-next against pinned PRs. Deterministic checks and two read-only graders score the result. Seven cases ship with frozen sources. LLM findings do not fail the process.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
